journal_entries.text: My wife signed us both up for this. Fine. Slept okay, kids are on summer schedule so mornings are loud.
Coached the under-10s Saturday. We lost 6-1 and they were thrilled anyway.
Work's steady. Started walking at lunch instead of eating at my desk.
Back-to-school chaos. Forms, shoes, a lost backpack. Normal.
Long weekend at the lake. No phone for two days. Should do that more.
journal_entries.ai_summary: Restorative time off; low screen use.

journal_entries.text: Denver conference. Good talks, bad sleep, came home with a cold.
Sick all week. Couch, tea, nothing done. Grumpy about it.
journal_entries.ai_summary: Acute illness; low energy and irritability.

journal_entries.text: Mostly better. Walks are back. Appetite's back.
Our team hit its number. Took everyone out. Good night.
Daughter's recital. She nailed it. I may have gotten something in my eye.
Quiet. Fixed the fence. Slept nine hours Saturday.
Three months in. Honestly nothing dramatic to report, which I think is the point.

voice_notes.transcript: Testing. Uh, day's fine. Kids are feral. That's all.
Lunch walk done. Trying to make it a thing.
I'm sick. Voice is gone, so this is short.
Better. Back to walking. Appetite is definitely back.
Recital was tonight. She was great. Proud dad noise.
Nothing to report. Good week. Bye.
